episodes.name: Prelude to a Storm
episodes.overview: When all the Ninja Academies in the world are destroyed by Lothor, only three young students, Shane, Tori and Dustin are not captured. Their Sensei gives them the powers to become the Wind Ninja Power Rangers and the daunting mission of saving the world.

episodes.name: There’s No "I" in Team
episodes.overview: When Shane decides to take on the Mad Magnet monster by himself, he learns that it takes teamwork and trust to overcome obstacles and maintain friendships.

episodes.name: Beauty and the Beach
episodes.overview: When Lothor's minions appeal to Tori's vanity, they lure her to a photo shoot then create her doppelganger to help them infiltrate the Ninja Ops.

episodes.name: Looming Thunder
episodes.overview: The others question Dustin's commitment to the Rangers when it seems he is spending too much time with his new motocross buddies, Blake and Hunter.

episodes.name: Thunder Strangers (1)
episodes.overview: The Thunder Rangers use the Tsunami Cycles and their Thunder Megazord to try and defeat the Wind Rangers.

episodes.name: Thunder Strangers (2)
episodes.overview: The Amphibidor monster tries to drain the city dry. Hunter and Blake reveal that they are the Thunder Rangers.

episodes.name: Thunder Strangers (3)
episodes.overview: When Hunter and Blake meet the ghosts of their parents in the Cavern of Lost Ninjas they learn that Lothor is responsible for their parents' deaths, not Sensei.

episodes.name: Nowhere to Grow
episodes.overview: The Power Rangers defend the city against Florabundacus, an evil monster who tries to destroy the world with carnivorous plants.

episodes.name: Return of Thunder (1)
episodes.overview: Hunter and Blake are fooled by Choobo, who erases their memories and pits them against the Wind Rangers.

episodes.name: Return of Thunder (2)
episodes.overview: All of the Rangers are transported to a sinking island where they battle each other.

episodes.name: Return of Thunder (3)
episodes.overview: Blake and the Wind Rangers must find a way to break Choobo's spell over Hunter.

episodes.name: Return of Thunder (4)
episodes.overview: Choobo takes his last stand against the Power Rangers.

episodes.name: Boxing Bopp-A-Roo
episodes.overview: Marah and Kapri send their alien boxing instructor, the Boxing Bopp-a-roo, to disrupt the Total Trek race that Shane and Hunter are running to prove who is more macho.

episodes.name: Pork Chopped
episodes.overview: The Power Rangers fight against Trayf, the Pig Monster, who traps them in his nightmare world.

episodes.name: The Samurai's Journey (1)
episodes.overview: Cam and his father quarrel because the Sensei is overprotective. Madtropolis drains the Rangers of their powers forcing Cam to go back to the past for a mysterious power source.

episodes.name: The Samurai's Journey (2)
episodes.overview: Cam travels back in time to the Wind Ninja Academy to gain the powers he needs to become the Green Ranger and to save the younger versions of his parents from the menace of his evil uncle, Lothor.

episodes.name: The Samurai's Journey (3)
episodes.overview: Lothor seeks revenge on Cam by sending five monsters at once to destroy the city.

episodes.name: Scent of a Ranger
episodes.overview: Cam's weird behavior comes at a bad time when Fragra captures two of the Rangers in perfume bottles.

episodes.name: I Love Lothor
episodes.overview: In an attempt to win over the hearts and minds of the Earth, Lothor and Mr. Ratwell produce a sitcom and administer a love potion.

episodes.name: Good Will Hunter
episodes.overview: Hunter mentors a kid who happens to acquire Lothor's Personal Alien Manager; the teens are excited about an action sports video contest.

episodes.name: All About Beevil
episodes.overview: Marah convinces Dustin that she wants to become a good person when she is replaced in the Lair by her friend Beevil.

episodes.name: Sensei Switcheroo
episodes.overview: In an attempt to make his father human again, Cam builds a machine that accidentally turns Sensei into Shane - leaving Shane a guinea pig.

episodes.name: Tongue and Cheek
episodes.overview: Dustin lets a bit of fame go to his head. Meanwhile, the Slob Goblin monster attacks the city, turning people into stamps.

episodes.name: Brothers in Arms
episodes.overview: A mild-mannered mechanic turns into a mutant creature that wants Crimson Ranger's power for a bizarre experiment.

episodes.name: Shane's Karma (1)
episodes.overview: A benevolent alien comes to Earth searching for a Red Power Ranger, while Sensei sends Shane on a life journey.

episodes.name: Shane's Karma (2)
episodes.overview: Shane receives a powerful gift from Skyla, while the Rangers continue to fight Zurgane Zord.

episodes.name: Shimazu Returns (1)
episodes.overview: As the teens prepare for a televised talent show, Motodrone brings to life Shimazu and the three Wolfblades.

episodes.name: Shimazu Returns (2)
episodes.overview: Cam must use all the Rangers' power disks to summon a new weapon strong enough to defeat Wolfblades.

episodes.name: Snip It, Snip It Good
episodes.overview: When Lothor tries to use the Snipster to break up an international peace conference, the Power Rangers must use their inner ninja skill, and a new weapon, to cut the Snipster down to size.

episodes.name: The Wild Wipeout
episodes.overview: Tori finds herself in a bizarre dimension where everything is the opposite of what she knows.

episodes.name: Double-Edged Blake
episodes.overview: Blake secretly trains with a new weapon that is tested when the Inflatron monster attacks.

episodes.name: Eye of the Storm
episodes.overview: Shane is worried when his judgmental older brother comes to visit. The Eyezak monster makes the Rangers see their greatest fears.

episodes.name: General Deception (1)
episodes.overview: The guys' plans to go camping are interrupted when Zurgane decides to defeat the Rangers on his own.

episodes.name: General Deception (2)
episodes.overview: Zurgane makes a last attempt to defeat the Rangers.

episodes.name: A Gem of a Day
episodes.overview: Cam uses the Gem of Souls to power a new vehicle.

episodes.name: Down and Dirty
episodes.overview: Marah and Kapri team up with Shimazu and attack in evil Zords. Blake and Hunter get in an argument.

episodes.name: Storm Before the Calm (1)
episodes.overview: Lothor begins his ultimate plan to take over the Earth.

episodes.name: Storm Before the Calm (2)
episodes.overview: The Rangers must stop Lothor from opening the Abyss of Evil.
